about: Load to Time on a sequence and on cues without a voice: the Fade auto-follows into the group Act One, so 7 s stands the Fade at its end and the group and its cues 2 s in (each row shows its time; the group's own row has no fill, its length unknown). Rain loops, so the sequence has no known end: the slider is off with its knob at the start, and -1 s loads the Fade at its start and unloads the group. A new standing-by cue clears the bar, and text that is not a time goes back to the last time loaded.
